newsitem.title: FRANCE: French boy, 7, says stabbed mother to death.
newsitem.headline: French boy, 7, says stabbed mother to death.

text.p: A seven-year-old French boy has said he stabbed his mother to death after she tried to strangle him, police said on Tuesday.

Police, who only have the boy's account to go on, said they were bewildered over how a young child could overpower an adult. Kevin said his Peruvian-born mother, who police said had been suffering depression, tried to throttle him when he awoke on Monday.
He said he grabbed a kitchen knife and stabbed her. Her body was found lying on the floor of the kitchen. Doctors who examined the child said he had marks around his neck.
